_notes: file: name inside --src. hfov: horizontal degrees the image covers. vfov: omit to derive from aspect ratio.
heading: compass azimuth (0=N, 90=E) of the image's horizontal centre. pitch: elevation of its vertical centre.
projection: 'equirect' or 'cylindrical'. lat/lon: planetocentric, east-positive, from MSLPLC LOCALIZATIONS for that sol.
Fields set to null must be filled before that pano builds; the build skips it otherwise.
lat/lon: PDS msl_places data_localizations/localized_pos.csv, last ROVER row at or before the pano's sol.
Mastcam pixel scales used for hfov where captions are silent: M-100 0.074 mrad/px, M-34 0.218 mrad/px; Navcam 0.82 mrad/px.
projection: NASA/MIPL 'cylindrical' mosaics are evenly spaced in elevation, so they build as 'equirect' (linear); the build's 'cylindrical' mode assumes tan spacing.
waypoint: optional app landmark id this panorama shows (at any distance: a rim view can look toward a waypoint 37 km away). Otherwise the app uses the nearest panorama within 3 km.
max_width: optional per-pano cap on the sphere width (default --width 8192); raise it for narrow, high-resolution strips.
download / bytes / sha256: the exact file fetch_raw.py downloads into raw/ and checks before use.

panos.title: Bradbury Landing
panos._how: 360 per caption; 7703 px / 360 deg = Navcam native scale. Heading: Mount Sharp (caption: top left) sits at 0-40% across with its high part near 20%; the terrain-grid horizon puts its peak at 134 deg and its end near 206 deg, so the centre faces ~242. The jagged north rim then falls between W and NE, as seen. Pitch: horizon at row 136 of 1678, 0.0467 deg/px: centre row looks 32.8 deg down.

panos.title: Rocknest
panos._how: Replaces the GigaPan source (no full-resolution download). Not a full circle (no rover deck or mosaic gaps). Caption: centre looks east, toward Point Lake. hfov from Mastcam M-34 scale: 13726 px x 0.218 mrad = 171 deg (vfov 37.6), which puts Mount Sharp at the right edge, as seen. Images taken Oct 5 - Nov 16 2012 (sols 59-100); position from the Rocknest site (sol 59 row). Pitch: horizon at row ~330 of 3008, 0.0125 deg/px.

panos.title: Point Lake, Yellowknife Bay
panos._how: Replaces the GigaPan source. Caption: spans 360 deg with south at the centre. Position: the Point Lake drive (sol 102 row, 25 m from Rocknest as the Rocknest caption states). Pitch: horizon at row ~240 of 3300, 0.0235 deg/px.

panos.title: Naukluft Plateau: north crater wall
panos._how: Caption: about 130 deg (M-100 scale gives 127), spanning west-northwest on the left to northeast on the right, peak A near the left end at azimuth 291.8; centre ~349. Pitch 0: the camera looks about level at the rim. max_width 16384: a narrow strip keeps about twice the detail of the default 8192 sphere.

panos.title: Gale's north rim and Peace Vallis
panos._how: Caption: Peace Vallis is near the centre; bearing from the rover to the Peace Vallis fan is 3.5 deg. hfov from Mastcam M-100 scale: 23951 px x 0.074 mrad = 101.5 deg (vfov 10.2; 44 frames as 2 rows of 22). Position: sol 4639 row. Pitch 0: the camera looks about level at the rim. max_width 16384: a narrow strip keeps about twice the detail of the default 8192 sphere.
